description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources within the combined training set used in the study “Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models.” The chart is divided into eleven distinct segments, each representing a different dataset and labeled with its name and corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored blue, represents the “FEVER” dataset at 31.3%. The second largest, in teal, is “MULTIFC” at 16.1%, followed by “SNLI” in orange at 15.4%. Other notable segments include “VITAMINC” (13.0%, light blue), “MULTINLI” (11.3%, pink), and “ANLI” (4.6%, dark orange). Smaller segments include “FACTCC” (2.6%, green), “ENTFA” (1.8%, yellow), “SCITAIL” (1.2%, light green), “XSUMHUL” (1.6%, very light blue), and “PUBHEALTH” and “MULTIFC” both at 0.5% (the latter appearing to be a duplicate label or error in the chart). The segments are arranged in descending order of size clockwise from the top, with percentage values clearly labeled and connected via leader lines to their respective slices. No legend is present, as labels are directly annotated on the chart. The visual emphasizes the dominance of FEVER and MULTIFC in the training data composition.
